title: Observing the emergence of a velocity hierarchy in matter waves
summary: Classical waves in dispersive media naturally exhibit distinct phase and group velocities. Whether an analogous separation of velocities can emerge in matter waves under strong many-body interactions has remained experimentally unexplored. Here, we demonstrate the emergence of a velocity hierarchy in a strongly interacting lattice gas. Using quench spectroscopy together with time-resolved correlation measurements, we independently determine the sound, group, and phase velocities across the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition.
